headline: Kumamoto quake aftermath: mall rescue ends as death toll reaches 34
summary: Authorities ended the five-day search at a collapsed mall, while more than 9,000 people remained in shelters and water shortages affected the region.
script: The hardest part of Japan's quake may be the recovery after rescue crews leave. A magnitude seven point one disaster killed thirty-four people, left more than nine thousand in shelters, and cut water supplies. Extreme heat makes survival and rebuilding even harder.
imageAlt: A damaged street and collapsed tiled roofs in Kumamoto after the earthquake.
